Welcome home, Tanisha. You finished KCSE the way you do everything: with heart, with focus, and with a quiet determination that never needed an audience. You worked hard, you tried new things, and you kept finding ways to make yourself better. We noticed every bit of it. It is all part of who you are today. We are so proud of you, and so happy you are home.

A letter for you

Dear Tanisha,

I have watched you work hard and keep growing, and I want you to know how proud I am. You did so many things to make yourself better, and you did them quietly and well.

As you start your next chapter, I wish you all the best in your studies. Be curious. Be brave. Enjoy the ride. And remember that this home, and everyone in it, is always yours.

I love you. Welcome home.

Imani ♥
